results.fact: length of the Sharkfin Col rappel onto the Boston Glacier
results.correct_value: Condition-dependent: one long rappel or two shorter ones, roughly 100-150 ft in all depending on snow and the bergschrund
results.evidence: Published figures genuinely vary with snow: an alpine club gives 150 ft, a guide service 100 ft, a 2015 party a 20 m rap (single 30 m rope with some downclimbing), another party ~40 m with an intermediate station, and a July 2025 party a double-rope rap into and out of the bergschrund with a second station for single-rope raps. Every source agrees the length depends on conditions and falls in roughly the 100-150 ft range, in one or two stages. The row stated a single fixed figure (100 ft in rappels, 150 ft in the waypoint and approach variant), so all copies are changed to the range.
